gate: G7 - the repo is safe to point an unattended loop at

sizeCheck.allowlist: .husky/large-files-allowlist.txt - the same file the pre-commit hook reads, so the two cannot disagree

featureMap.driftRule: a change touching a domain area updates that area file in the same commit

exitCommand: pnpm run size:check && pnpm run health && pnpm run type-check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test -- --run
whyItIsAStage: the plan asks whether the repo is safe to point an unattended loop at; conformant is not the same as drivable, and R4/R5/R6 all need somewhere to put the evidence they capture
